modmenu.descriptionTranslation.ssc-prima: The official addon of Shape Shifter Curse: adds gameplay centered on instinct control for feral forms. As your Primal Instinct progresses, you will be granted greater power.. at only a tiny, negligible cost. Will you answer the call of the Primal Instinct?
text.ssc-primalstinct.config.server_hint: Server config takes effect after restart / re-entering the world; in multiplayer, the server's local file is authoritative
text.ssc-primalstinct.config.title: Shape Shifter's Curse - Primal Instinct Config
Primal Call chance per mob kill
item.ssc-primalstinct.primal_instinct_fa: It has no effect. The Primal Instinct rejects your current form.
power.ssc-primalstinct.bed_spawn_only.de: Beds can only set your spawn point; you cannot sleep in them.
power.ssc-primalstinct.prevent_villager_: Villagers will refuse to trade with you.
ssc-primalstinct.selection.title: Choose Your Form
ssc-primalstinct.selection.waiting: Waiting for the server to confirm...
ssc-primalstinct.form.shape-shifter-curs: A pack leader that summons hosts of wolf spirits to fight, turning withering decay into its own strength.
A magical creature altered by outside magic, keeping company with witches and illagers, feeding on the energy of other beings.
A hunter that feeds on raw meat, can climb, and hunts with sweeping claws - but burns through its hunger quickly.
A predator that draws on cold magic, attacks with leaps and empowered snowballs, and springs swiftly across the land - but fears fire greatly.
hud.ssc-primalstinct.level_down: You sense the Primal Instinct in your heart shrink back, and your thoughts grow a little clearer.
hud.ssc-primalstinct.level_up: The Primal Instinct within you grows stronger.
hud.ssc-primalstinct.level_up.1: The primal instinct awakens from your blood. You can feel it growing stronger bit by bit.. This will have consequences.
hud.ssc-primalstinct.level_up.2: As the Primal Instinct strengthens, you feel more at home in this body. Perhaps that is not a bad thing..
hud.ssc-primalstinct.level_up.3: You have grown stronger. Though your body occasionally refuses to obey your commands, and your reading has been somewhat affected - but it is nothing much.. probably.
hud.ssc-primalstinct.level_up.4: You can barely tell the Primal Instinct apart from your own will anymore. You had better think of something.. if you do not want to become a beast entirely.
hud.ssc-primalstinct.level_up.locked: You open your eyes. A beast needs no extra thoughts.
chat.ssc-primalstinct.primal_call.starte: Some primal call echoes within your heart... Before it fully awakens, there may still be a chance to dispel its effect.
chat.ssc-primalstinct.remnant.range_exha: The answers nearby have all gone silent. Explore farther afield.
chat.ssc-primalstinct.threshold_approach: Your instinct is about to reach its next stage...
message.ssc-primalstinct.bed_uncomfortab:
You try to sleep in the bed, but the feel of the fabric is unbearable.
Curling up on the ground should be more comfortable.
message.ssc-primalstinct.drop_certain: Unable to bear the feel of wielding a tool, you fling it aside in disgust.
message.ssc-primalstinct.drop_random: You blank for a moment - the tool slips from your grasp without you noticing.
message.ssc-primalstinct.interaction_cer: You rack your memory, but you cannot recall how this thing is used..
message.ssc-primalstinct.interaction_ran: You suddenly forget what this thing is even for.. strange.
message.ssc-primalstinct.villager_refuse: The villager looks at you in puzzlement, unable to make out what your cries mean.
ssc-primalstinct.sleep.need_ground: You must be on the ground to curl up.
ssc-primalstinct.sleep.no_vehicle: You cannot curl up inside a vehicle.
ssc-primalstinct.sleep.unavailable: You can only curl up to sleep at night.
It has no effect on you at all.
The primal instinct fades from your heart, and at last your mind feels clear again.
codex.ssc-primalstinct.instincts.open_hi:
Something you are not familiar with - something like instinct, yet more [primal] - has begun to take root in your heart
You are quite sure it will bring some consequences..
codex.ssc-primalstinct.page.back: Back to the Book of the Shapeshifter
codex.ssc-primalstinct.page.title: Primal Instinct
codex.ssc-primalstinct.page.form.shape-s:
My body seems to have undergone some changes; they are still subtle. I feel a little uneasy
> I seem to move a little faster, and jump a little higher
> Raw meat now seems to bring me greater satiety
> My forepaws' capacity for fine work has declined, making it hard to carry as many items as before
> Sleeping on the ground feels just as comfortable as in a bed. I can sleep soundly through the night anywhere

These thoughts linger in my mind:
> The urge to enter the jungle, to stay with my kind, and to bring them food haunts my heart
> The thought of pouncing on enemies, striking livestock with my claws, and enjoying their flesh excites me
> When I successfully dodge an incoming arrow, I feel a thrill of excitement

If I do not wish to give up my self entirely, I must stay clear-headed:
> Soaking in water calms my mind a little
> Being near villagers makes my thoughts clearer
> The pain of an arrow wound, strangely, sharpens my thinking

I feel more at home in this body, but at times it seems to work against me. Staying calm helps
> My paws have grown stronger. My movement speed, jump height, and claw-sweep damage have all improved further. I can even dig some blocks with my claws directly, without any tool
> I can sense every move of nearby prey through scent alone; there is no escape for them
> When sleeping, the bed feels strange to the touch. The ground seems more comfortable than any mattress..
> The dexterity of my forepaws has not improved. I can hardly carry as many items as before
> Now and then I suddenly forget how some blocks are used.. a little odd

These thoughts linger in my mind:
> The urge to enter the jungle, to stay with my kind, and to bring them food haunts my heart
> The thought of pouncing on enemies, striking livestock with my claws, and enjoying their flesh excites me
> When I successfully dodge an incoming arrow, I feel a thrill of excitement

If I do not wish to give up my self entirely, I must stay clear-headed:
> Soaking in water calms my mind a little
> Being near villagers makes my thoughts clearer
> The pain of an arrow wound, strangely, sharpens my thinking

I feel in superb shape. Power fills my whole body; my spirits are high. Perhaps this primal instinct can work for me..
> My body has never felt so resilient, so full of life. I can move as lightly as the wind
> My foreclaws are exceedingly sharp, yet hard enough to dig through most blocks. But their dexterity is now barely enough to craft items by hand. I need to think of something
> What unsettles me is that using blocks keeps getting harder and harder. Tools slip from my grip without my noticing while I use them, as if my body were rejecting them
> I can no longer sleep in a bed. How did I ever bear the mushy, sinking feel of a mattress?
> When I zone out, my body starts wandering on its own. I must concentrate to regain control
> While reading, I find the meaning of some words turning blurry.. surely nothing serious

These thoughts linger in my mind:
> The urge to enter the jungle, to stay with my kind, and to bring them food haunts my heart
> The thought of pouncing on enemies, striking livestock with my claws, and enjoying their flesh excites me
> When I successfully dodge an incoming arrow, I feel a thrill of excitement
> The idea of letting the Primal Instinct take over my body entirely and roam freely begins to attract me
> At the sight of my prey, I cannot suppress my thrill
> When I try my hardest yet cannot recall how some blocks are used, and cannot help but cast my tools away, I feel something inside me slipping away

If I do not wish to give up my self entirely, I must stay clear-headed:
> Soaking in water calms my mind a little
> Being near villagers makes my thoughts clearer
> The pain of an arrow wound, strangely, sharpens my thinking
> When I successfully use a tool, I feel some of my old self returning

I must concentrate hard to control my own body. Sometimes I can no longer tell which actions come from my own will
> The primal power keeps growing stronger, reshaping my body as it does..
> My altered muzzle, tongue and throat now perfectly serve the oxygen demands of the endless hunt and the need to tear prey apart.. at the cost of my speech. When I try to talk, all that comes out are strange hisses and whimpers
> I find myself deeply reluctant to use tools; even using blocks takes considerable effort - if this goes on, I may lose the ability to use them entirely
> When I scent nearby prey, primal impulse completely seizes my heart - by the time I come to, a trophy is already clamped in my jaws
> Spending the night curled on the ground now feels perfectly natural; I can barely remember what sleeping in a bed was like
..If I do not want to lose my self entirely, I must think of something
